'''Hysalrians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]], four-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], semi-[[Snake/Legends|serpentine]] individuals who hailed from a [[Unidentified swamp planet|swamp world]] and the [[Hysalria system/Legends|Hysalria system]]. One of their members, [[N'Kata Del Gormo/Legends|N'Kata Del Gormo]], trained eventual [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Biology and appearance==
Hysalrians were considered strange-looking, and featured serpentine lower halves. Their upper halves were vaguely more [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], although they featured four [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. Their heads featured a small mouth, and four [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], which were small and black. The skin of the Hysalrian was a muted green, and their underbellies were white and segmented.<ref name="daa" />

==History==
The Hysalrians were native to a [[Unidentified swamp planet|swamp planet]],<ref name="daa" /> as well as the [[Hysalria system/Legends|Hysalria system]].<ref name="teao">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> One Hysalrian, [[N'Kata Del Gormo/Legends|N'Kata Del Gormo]], lived on the swamp [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. When two other Force-sensitives, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and a [[Unidentified Force-sensitive Human|Human]], crashed on the planet, Del Gormo trained them in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Yoda and the Human were later rescued by [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="daa" /> Yoda went on to become the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="ydr">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Hysalrians were created by [[Chuck Hamilton]], a 23-year-old ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan, through the "[[Design An Alien]]" competition, which was run by ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''. The competition, which was launched in [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 3|''Star Wars Galaxy Magazine'' 3]] ([[1995]]), called for readers to conjure up entirely new alien species based on what had been shown in the [[original trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. Hamilton's entry was not included in the winners showcased in [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 7|''Star Wars Galaxy Magazine'' 7]] ([[1996]]), but was later printed in the "honorable mentions" section in [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 9|''Star Wars Galaxy Magazine'' 9]] (1996).

[[Holocron continuity database]] keeper [[Leland Chee]] has stated that the published "Design an Alien" material is considered [[canon]] unless contradicted by another source.<ref name="tt">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=Star Wars Galaxy Magazine #7 published the winners of the 'Design an Alien' contest, where fans were encouraged to submit artwork and backstories of new SW aliens. Are these aliens canon? [...] Yes, though any text discrepencies [''sic''] with other sources would likely to superceded [''sic''] by the other source.}}</ref> Hamilton's original entry stated that the Hysalrians were native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], and that N'Kata Del Gormo had trained Yoda there. This was later contradicted when Chee stated that, per the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']] novel ([[2005]]), Yoda's trip to Dagobah in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] was his first ever trip there, which would have occurred long after his original training. Chee did state, however, that the character of N'Kata Del Gormo did still exist in canon.<ref name="tt2">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=14866609#14864813|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-24|time=1:31 PM}}</ref> As such, an unidentified swamp world is substituted for Dagobah for the purposes of this article. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ([[2009]]) furthermore established a "Hysalria," as a homeworld for the Hysalrians, but no explicit connection has been made between the swamp world and Hysalria. Author [[Jason Fry]] did, however, place Hysalria close to Dagobah to solidify the connection, and also intended to imply a connection between the Hysalrians and the [[Sluissi]].<ref name="jcf">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31050539|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-07-02|time=8:40 PM}}</ref>
